description: tests/hud-negative/compass-wrong.json, the ui_hud_corpus_wrong control (PL.native-hud-rows): core's compass corpus (conformance/ui/compass-cases.json at the pin) cut to three cases and doctored. The contract states defaultSpanDegrees 140 (the row states 150), a refusal code the rows never answer (teleported) and a key no runner holds (wrongRule); one case expects a wrong heading, one names an op core's runner does not have. The runner must name each and FAIL.
